title: TRST
scene: Toronto electro-goth / coldwave revival and dark synth-pop
sounds_like: Crystal Castles|Xeno & Oaklander|Depeche Mode|Pet Shop Boys|Erasure|Cut Copy
notes: Subterranean synth-pop combines narcotic nightclub propulsion, jagged vocal roles and deliberate emotional distance.

title: Joyland
scene: Toronto dark synth-pop / gothic club music and 1990s dance references
notes: Alfons stretches vocal extremes across bigger club rhythms, menacing synth bass and brighter choruses.

title: The Destroyer – 1
scene: Los Angeles / Toronto darkwave and industrial-tinged synth-pop
sounds_like: The Soft Moon|Silent Servant|VNV Nation|Crystal Castles|Joy Division
notes: The return of Postepski brings spacious, bruised synth-pop alongside forceful dancefloor passages.

title: The Destroyer – 2
scene: Los Angeles melancholic darkwave / ambient-leaning synth-pop

notes: The quieter Destroyer half favors piano, exposed vocals, cavernous synthesizers and intermittent club beats.
